item.title: The Only Punk Band Ozzy Osbourne Ever Liked (Even Though He Couldn't Stand the Singer)
item.description: By the late 1970s, punk rock was gaining momentum. Ozzy Osbourne, however, was already deep into his career, with Black Sabbath having helped lay the foundation for what would become heavy metal.
